userStories.title: Dataset download script and reference document
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a download script and reference document that fetches all raw datasets into /data/dtMol_Project/datasets/ so I can run the full pipeline locally.
acceptanceCriteria: New file dtmol/data/download.py — CLI script invokable as python -m dtmol.data.download
Supports --data-root (default /data/dtMol_Project/datasets/), --source <name> for single dataset, --all for all auto-downloadable datasets

Auto-downloadable: ANI-2x (Zenodo 10108942, ~7GB HDF5 to <root>/ANI-2x/), SPICE2 (Zenodo 8222043, ~3GB to <root>/SPICE2/), Transition1x/IRC (Zenodo 7793881, ~9GB to <root>/Transition1x/), PDB_apo (~100 PDB files from RCSB to <root>/PDB_apo/)
MISATO: downloads QM portion (~300MB) by default to <root>/MISATO/; --misato-md flag for full MD (133GB) with confirmation prompt
Detects already-present datasets: QM9 at <root>/QM9/raw/gdb9.sdf, PDBBind at <root>/PDBBind/pdbbind.lmdb/ — prints FOUND and skips
--check flag: scans --data-root and prints table of all 7 datasets with FOUND/MISSING status and file sizes
Downloads support resume (wget -c or requests with range headers) and show progress
New file dtmol/data/DATASETS.md with table per dataset: name, source URL, size, license, citation, raw format, converter command
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PDB apo downloads use a curated list of ~100 representative PDB IDs embedded in the script, overridable via --pdb-list file.
test_assertions: cd /home/haotiant/Projects/CMU/dtmol && python3 -m dtmol.data.download --help exits 0 and output contains '--data-root' and '--check' and '--source'
cd /home/haotiant/Projects/CMU/dtmol && python3 -m dtmol.data.download --check --data-root /data/dtMol_Project/datasets exits 0 and output contains 'QM9' and 'PDBBind'
userStories.implementation_notes: Created dtmol/data/download.py CLI script and dtmol/data/DATASETS.md reference document. Download script supports --data-root, --source, --all, --check, --misato-md, --pdb-list flags. Auto-downloadable datasets: ANI-2x (Zenodo 10108942), SPICE2 (Zenodo 8222043), Transition1x (Zenodo 7793881), PDB_apo (RCSB, 100 curated IDs), MISATO QM (Zenodo 7711953). QM9 and PDBBind are detected as FOUND and skipped. Downloads use requests with range headers for resume support and tqdm for progress. Typecheck passes with --ignore-missing-imports.

userStories.title: Convert QM9 to unified LMDB
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to convert the already-downloaded QM9 dataset at /data/dtMol_Project/datasets/QM9/raw/ to unified LMDB format.
acceptanceCriteria: QM9 converter handles the existing CSV format: columns mol_id,A,B,C,mu,alpha,homo,lumo,gap,r2,zpve,u0,u298,h298,g298,cv (case-insensitive column matching or explicit mapping for u0->U0, mol_id->idx)
Running python -m dtmol.data.convert --source qm9 --input /data/dtMol_Project/datasets/QM9/raw --output /data/dtMol_Project/datasets/QM9/unified produces train.lmdb, valid.lmdb, test.lmdb
Spot-check first 5 records: dataset_source=='qm9', pes_tier=='C', forces is None, energy is finite float in eV range (-2000 to -500), homo/lumo in eV
Record count across splits is ~130K total (QM9 has ~134K molecules)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The existing CSV at gdb9.sdf.csv uses column names mol_id/u0 vs the converter's expected idx/U0. Fix the converter to handle actual column names.
test_assertions: python3 -c "import lmdb; env=lmdb.open('/data/dtMol_Project/datasets/QM9/unified/train.lmdb', readonly=True, lock=False); n=env.stat()['entries']; assert n > 100000, f'Only {n} records'; print(f'QM9 train: {n} records OK')" exits 0

python3 -c "import lmdb, pickle; env=lmdb.open('/data/dtMol_Project/datasets/QM9/unified/train.lmdb', readonly=True, lock=False); txn=env.begin(); _,v=next(txn.cursor().iternext()); rec=pickle.loads(v); assert rec['dataset_source']=='qm9'; assert rec['pes_tier']=='C'; assert rec['forces'] is None; assert rec['energy'] is not None; print('OK')" exits 0

PDBBind: component_mask has both 0 and 1, num_atoms > 10
MISATO: trajectory_id is a 4-char PDB ID, component_mask present, num_atoms > 50
PDB apo: all component_mask entries are 0, num_atoms > 20
Tests skip with clear message if a dataset LMDB is not found
pytest dtmol/data/tests/test_converters_real.py -v exits 0
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: These tests validate the output of US-003 through US-009. They run against real converted LMDBs, not synthetic data.

userStories.title: DatasetMixer and training loop integration test on real mixed data
userStories.description: As a developer, I want an integration test that builds a DatasetMixer from all available real datasets, runs DiffusionTrainer.train_step on mixed batches, and verifies losses are finite with correct tier-aware force loss.
acceptanceCriteria: New file dtmol/data/tests/test_train_integration.py
Test builds DatasetMixer from datamix_default.yaml, skipping datasets whose LMDB is not found; requires at least 2 datasets available
Builds encoder/decoder using pretrain dicts, creates DiffusionTrainer, runs train_step on 3 batches with batch_size=2 on CPU
Loss is finite (not NaN, not Inf) for all batches
Loss dict contains keys: total_loss, diffusion_loss, force_loss, trrot_loss, pert_loss
When Tier A data present and lambda_force > 0, tier_a_force_loss appears in at least one batch loss dict
When Tier B data present and lambda_fd_force > 0, tier_b_force_loss appears in at least one batch loss dict
Separate test function: legacy mode regression — loads PDBBind from /data/unimol_data/protein_ligand_binding_pose_prediction/, runs one train_step, checks finite loss (skips if unavailable)
Tests skip gracefully if pretrain dicts missing
pytest dtmol/data/tests/test_train_integration.py -v --timeout=180 exits 0
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the end-to-end smoke test. Uses real data, real model, real loss. Runs on CPU with small batch to keep it fast.
test_assertions: cd /home/haotiant/Projects/CMU/dtmol && python3 -m pytest dtmol/data/tests/test_train_integration.py -v output contains at least one 'PASSED'
